thread:
Maya Chen: Quick async — what I did: finished perf run for tokenizer improvements and merged patch to reduce KV cache churn. Blockers: intermittent e2e failure on feature/model-routing that looks infra-related. Today: triage the e2e flakes, prepare a small rollback plan if canary shows regression. Ask: @Alex can you re-trigger the canary after I push the fix? :coffee:

Alex Rivera: Yep I can do that. FYI I saw higher latencies on the canary last night, might be related to batch sizing change. I'll run a smoke and post results here.

Priya Patel: Happy to help with e2e triage — I can take the failing test and add extra logging. Which test is it?

Maya Chen: Thanks @Priya — it's tests/integration/model_routing_test.py, failure around the fallback path. It times out after 60s. I reproduced locally with docker-compose.

Jordan Lee: Noticed an infra spike around 03:10 UTC, maybe correlated. Logs show a bunch of OOMs on session-host-7. Snippet:
```
[2026-02-14T03:10:12Z] host=session-host-7 oom_killer invoked, process=redwood-runtime pid=8421
[2026-02-14T03:10:12Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 8421 (redwood-runtime) score 987
```
I'm kicking off a node drain on that host to repro in isolation.

Sam O'Neill: small heads-up — I have a failing CI job tied to the same PR, looks like a test ordering flake. I'm going to try a bisect. CR: #4821 might need a quick patch.

Alex Rivera: Canary smoke results: generation latency 95th went from 420ms -> 720ms on the canary with batch_size=16. Heap pressure was higher. Reverted batch_size to 8 and latency back to ~430ms. I can re-run once Maya's fix lands.

Maya Chen: Perfect, I'll push the patch in ~15m and @Alex can re-trigger. @deploy-bot can you hold any scheduled canary rollouts on the service 'redwood-runtime' until we confirm? :point_up:

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollouts for redwood-runtime have been paused by request of @Maya Chen. Existing canary remains live; further rollouts will be blocked until manually resumed.

Priya Patel: I'll add extra logging to model_routing_test and push a debug PR — will ping here once done.

Jordan Lee: Node drain started on session-host-7, collecting logs to /tmp/drain-logs.tar.gz, will attach when finished.

Maya Chen: Thanks team — plan: (1) Priya adds logs, (2) I push hotfix, (3) Alex reruns canary, (4) Jordan confirms node stability. Will update this thread when each step completes. :white_check_mark:
